facts.fact: The National Identity Cards Act, 2011 (Act 9 of 2011), an Act of Parliament published in Government Gazette 33 on 21 March 2011, commenced on 1 July 2013 and repealed the National Identity Cards Act, 2004.
facts.system: National Identity Cards Act, 2011 (Act 9 of 2011); National Identity Register and national identity card

facts.fact: The National Identity Cards Act, 2011 establishes a National Identity Register that records fingerprints and an image for persons aged sixteen and over, assigns each entry a unique National Identity Number, and provides for an identity card with a chip holding fingerprints.
